title: IdeaSeek idea candidates envelope (idea-candidates-v1)
description: Envelope for the ARIS idea-creator output: a candidates array (may be honestly empty, with an optional reason). Envelope-level check only — per-card structural validation is idea-card-v1 applied inside the parse loop so partial batches keep their rejected-card semantics; the mechanism gate and fingerprint/duplicate checks stay TS.

candidates.description: Item shape is validated per card by idea-card-v1 inside the parse loop so partial batches keep their rejected-card semantics (an invalid card is collected, not fatal).
